programme.desc: Lisa's life, a high-level athlete, loses meaning when she is released from the team. George, a businessman, is wrongly accused of a tax crime. And it's when everything seemed to fall apart in both of their lives, that the two met!

In addition, Max's ex-husband furiously pursues them very closely.

programme.title: Crank: High voltage
programme.desc: Hitman Chelios faces off against a Chinese gangster who has stolen his virtually indestructible heart and replaced it with a sophisticated battery-powered device that requires frequent bursts of electricity to continue functioning.

programme.title: the whole truth
programme.desc: Tom is accused of having murdered innocent civilians in El Salvador, fifteen years ago, in a secret military operation. His wife, Claire, is ready to discover the whole truth...

programme.title: John Q
programme.desc: John Q. Archibald is an ordinary man, who works for hours in a factory to support his family. John lives focused on his wife Denise and his son Michael, to whom he dedicates practically all of his time. Everything goes wrong when their son falls ill and the hospital tells them that he needs a heart transplant as soon as possible, otherwise he will die. The child does not have medical insurance that covers the intervention, so he is outside the allocation plan and the prognosis is very negative. Seeing how his son awaits the fatal outcome and without money with which to face the operation, John decides to make a decision that may save his life, even if it involves breaking some limits.

programme.title: Conan the destroyer
programme.desc: Queen Taramis entrusts Conan with a very dangerous mission: to accompany Princess Jehnna on a long journey for which she was born predestined. Their objective is to recover a jewel that is in the possession of a powerful sorcerer. If he succeeds, the queen promises that she will help him recover Valeria, his great love. But the monarch's intentions are very different since with the jewel she wants to bring an ancient god back to life.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Natalie Cook, Dylan Sanders and Alex Munday are three special agents with overwhelming fighting and combat capabilities. But although each one is very different from the others, they will all be hired by a man named Charlie to carry out a special and very dangerous mission: find Eric Knox, a computer genius kidnapped because of his latest invention: an incredibly precise voice scanner. Through their investigations, Natalie, Dylan and Alex will discover clues that will lead them across the entire world, exuding charm and femininity to achieve their goals and destroying anyone who gets in their way. Drew Barrymore was a huge fan of the "Harry Potter" phenomenon, going so far as to read small parts of the different books to the members of the recording crew and the other actors. At the beginning of the film, when she is seen with glasses and black hair before being hired, she is also reading a Harry Potter book.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: The Edge
programme.desc: Second part of Charlie's Angels. Dylan, Natalie and Alex are sent by their boss on a new mission: locate a group of rings that have been stolen from the Department of Justice. This device allows its owner to know the list of people who are in the FBI's Witness Protection Program. When the first witnesses begin to appear dead, the Angels will have to use all their ingenuity to solve the case. An exceptional cameo can be seen in this film: one of the original Angels, Jaclyn Smith.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Due to radioactive mutations that man has been producing over the years for decades, the sea monster Godzilla appears from the depths of the sea to try to stop a series of monsters, animated by man's scientific arrogance, that threaten to destroy humanity.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Baby is a young man passionate about music and a talented getaway driver, taking criminals from one point to another to the rhythm of his personal soundtrack. It plots your escape route based on the songs coming out of your iPod and converts them into perfectly synchronized movements. Baby works for Doc, a big-shot crime boss who's on a roll robbing banks in broad daylight thanks to Baby's driving skills. In the same criminal gang there are other professionals such as Buddy, a former stockbroker, Darling, Buddy's wild and scandalous young accomplice, and Bats, an impulsive gunman whose suspicions about Baby begin to cause problems in the operation. When Baby meets the girl of his dreams, a sweet waitress named Débora, he sees an opportunity to abandon his life of crime and make a clean getaway, but decides to complete one last mission before retiring. However, Doc is not going to make it easy for him, so the young driver will have to fight for his love and his freedom.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Texas. Two years before the American Civil War broke out. King Schultz is a German bounty hunter who is tracking murderers to collect for their heads, and he promises the black slave Django to set him free on the condition that he helps him catch them. Django accepts, since his greatest wish is to go rescue his wife Broomhilda, a slave who is on the plantation of landowner Calvin Candie. This film, written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, is a western film with references to the spaghetti western genre; genre through which I wanted to portray a story about slavery like this one. Tarantino is a renowned American director, producer and screenwriter whose films are characterized by addressing non-linear stories, violence, Grindhouse influences, kung fu and spaghetti westerns. Starring Jamie Foxx ('Bait', 'Collateral'), Christoph Waltz ('Inglourious Basterds', 'Dorian'), Leonardo DiCaprio ('Titanic', 'The Great Gatsby') and Samuel L. Jackson ('S.W.A.T.', 'Star Wars'); The film is a mix of good dialogue, rhythm, irony, and an impeccable soundtrack that allows it to capture the viewer's attention at all times.

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: Filmed entirely in the Philippines, "Platoon" tells us about the year a young university student named Chris spends in a regiment, who decides to volunteer for the Vietnam War. First part of a trilogy directed and written by Oliver Stone about the Vietnam War (followed by Born on the Fourth of July and Between Heaven and Earth). The protagonist of this story is a young Charlie Sheen, accompanied by a cast among which we highlight Willem Dafoe, Tom Berenger or some at that time still unknown Forest Whitaker or Johnny Depp. "Platoon" was the first film about Vietnam written and directed by a veteran of that war. Oliver Stone created this masterpiece taken from the experiences that he himself lived on the battlefield in his year as a soldier, filming almost a documentary where he tells us in first person through a character named Chris all his experiences in Vietnam. We are thus witnessing one of the most precise and realistic war films that recount this conflict with excellent direction, a script and impeccable editing. As for the exteriors, they are very well detailed and this perfection makes the viewer quickly immerse themselves in the war atmosphere that surrounds everything without rest. Definitely, a spectacular film that shows what until then Hollywood always tried to hide and the best way to get closer to what those days in Vietnam really were. Classic of the eighties and universal cinema.

programme.title: Dangerous instinct
programme.desc: A retired hitman is headed to his brother's funeral on a remote island when a group of mercenaries burst in looking for the money his brother owes them. With the support of Dr. Oberfeld, FBI agent Shaughnessy and the local sheriff, a tireless search for revenge will begin.

programme.title: Night of Vengeance
programme.desc: Vincent is a divorced man with a teenage son, Thomas, with whom he barely has a relationship. He works as a police officer in Los Angeles, dealing with corrupt matters hidden from Internal Affairs. After a heist in which he steals a shipment of cocaine from a dealer in Las Vegas, Vincent and his partner Sean Cass volunteer to investigate the case in order to hide their guilt and involvement from Internal Affairs. One afternoon when Vincent is walking with his son, the group of criminals from whom he stole cocaine corners him and kidnaps Thomas, threatening to end his life if he does not return the drugs. The leaders of Internal Affairs suspect Vincent and decide to investigate him. He only has one night to recover his son safe and sound, return the drug shipment, hide the truth from his ex-partner and cleanse his image in front of the heads of Internal Affairs.

programme.title: Life at stake
programme.desc: The film delves into the story of Sean Porter, Camp Kilpatrick juvenile detention camp probation officer and retired player, and his partner, Officer Malcolm Moore, who turned a group of dangerous juvenile delinquents into the Camp Kilpatrick Mustangs football team, having a fantastic season in 1990 and reaching the regional championship final against the Montclair Prep High School team. Porter will teach the boys to go against gang rivalries and bitter hatreds between peers, and both he and the young men will learn difficult lessons about life while the boys also acquire a sense of responsibility and self-respect.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, commander of the team, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: Agent 47 has been genetically engineered to become an effective and lethal hitman, working under instructions from a mysterious group known as 'The Organization'. However, when he finds himself involved in a political conspiracy that is beyond his understanding, he will turn against what he has known until now to try to find out who has set him up. While Interpol and the Russian army search for him throughout Europe, the murderer will have to face two new elements in his life: conscience and love.

programme.title: Hitman. Agent 47
programme.desc: Based on the famous video game, Hitman is an elite assassin who has been genetically modified to become a perfect killing machine. Identified only by a barcode that he has tattooed, his target is a corporation that aims to reveal his past and create assassins more powerful than him.

programme.title: John Q
programme.desc: John Q. Archibald is an ordinary man, who works for hours in a factory to support his family. John lives focused on his wife Denise and his son Michael, to whom he dedicates practically all of his time. Everything goes wrong when their son falls ill and the hospital tells them that he needs a heart transplant as soon as possible, otherwise he will die. The child does not have medical insurance that covers the intervention, so he is outside the allocation plan and the prognosis is very negative. Seeing how his son awaits the fatal outcome and without money with which to face the operation, John decides to make a decision that may save his life, even if it involves breaking some limits.

programme.title: The jury
programme.desc: A young New Orleans widow files a civil lawsuit against a powerful corporate consortium whom she blames for her husband's death. Thus, a multimillion-dollar case is launched. Judicial thriller based on a novel by John Grisham, a best-selling writer who is well versed in all the ins and outs of United States law.

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: MI6 agent Ray Koval (Clive Owen) is in Dubai when he meets Claire Stenwick (Julia Roberts). After groping her a little, he manages to win her over and they spend the night together, without knowing that Claire is part of the CIA. When Ray wakes up the next day, the woman has disappeared with several compromised documents. For years, Ray searches for her, leaves his job at MI6 and gets a new one in the espionage department of a large multinational. In his third week of work he meets Claire again. Now they both work as spies for large companies and Claire is not willing to allow anyone to come and destroy the professional future she has been building for just over a year. The two spies will use all kinds of tricks to keep their positions, but they will also have to fight against the great attraction they feel for each other so as not to succumb to the other person's deceptions. In this film, actor Clive Owen plays MI6 spy Ray Koval. Owen began his career in television, working mainly on not very well-known series. Currently, although he still makes some stellar appearances on television, he is one of the best-known faces on the big screen. He has worked in films such as 'The Bourne Affair', 'King Arthur' and 'Closer' where he shares the bill for the first time with actress Julia Roberts. In 'Duplicity', Roberts plays Claire Stenwick, a retired CIA agent. The acclaimed actress began her career in 1987, in the series 'The History of Crime'. After that she worked in several films until she gained fame through 'Pretty Woman' and her starring role alongside actor Richard Gere. From there her career took off and her charming smile made her 'America's Sweetheart'. He played several leading roles in romantic comedies but he has always tried to combine it with more serious roles such as those he played in 'Stay by me' or 'Erin Brockovich'.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Spencer is a top secret government agent with a license to kill who decides to quit his job when he finds and marries the woman of his dreams. But happiness is short-lived, since they have put a price on his head. He doesn't know who is after him, but he knows that there are several murderers and that it could be anyone. His neighbors, his friends, former colleagues, his current co-workers... Spencer will team up with his wife to find out who the mysterious characters are who want him dead before the bullies finish them off... and their marriage!

programme.title: run like a girl
programme.desc: The true story of Michelle Payne, the first female jockey to win the Melbourne Cup. An inspiring story of effort, family, friendship and courage in the face of the impossible.

programme.title: Better... impossible
programme.desc: Melvin Udall is a novelist with obsessive-compulsive disorder that, among other things, causes him to walk down the street without stepping on sidewalk lines or to use new cutlery every time he eats. But Melvin is also proud of his ability to offend and irritate others, especially his neighbor Simon Nye, a homosexual artist whom the writer always attacks with his viperous tongue. Melvin has breakfast every day in a cafeteria and there is only one waitress who can put up with him, Carol, a single mother struggling to raise her asthmatic son. The fate of these characters will be intertwined because of a dog and a trip.

programme.title: The client
programme.desc: Mark Sway is an eleven-year-old boy who witnesses the death of a mafia lawyer. Before dying, he confesses some very important information to him. But, fearing retaliation, Mark doesn't dare tell the FBI. The FBI pressures Mark to reveal the lawyer's last words, but he, aware that the mafia is watching him, decides to hire a lawyer to protect him. Adaptation of the best seller of the same name by John Grisham, directed by Joel Schumacher (''A Day of Fury'', ''Batman Forever''). Its plot starting point is vaguely reminiscent of that of ''Sole Witness'', although the Mormon community that surrounded Harrison Ford in Peter Weir's film is replaced here by a single character: that of a devoted lawyer. For this reason, the true core of the film, despite being a thriller, is not the judicial plot, but the relationship established between the boy, played by Brad Renfro (chosen from 5,000 candidates), and his lawyer, a role entrusted to Susan Sarandon, for which she was nominated for an Oscar for best actress. Tommy Lee Jones gave life to the third party, in the shoes of an ambitious prosecutor.

programme.title: The general's daughter
programme.desc: Officer Paul Brenner was investigating a dark case of corruption in the United States Army when Captain Elizabeth Campbell, daughter of the legendary General Joe Campbell, is violently murdered under strange conditions. His magnificent record and the excellent professional relationships that united him with the rest of the troops immediately direct the investigation towards a personal motive as the motive for the crime, something that, in Elizabeth's case, makes the authorities of the army's criminal investigation division fear the worst.

programme.title: The wanted
programme.desc: Henry Fonda is a priest persecuted by the authorities after the government has banned religion. His decision is to flee to another country, but at the border he will have difficulty getting out and will have to disguise himself. The film, directed by John Ford, is based on a novel by Graham Greene.

programme.title: While the city sleeps
programme.desc: Two police officers find themselves at opposite ends of their careers as they find themselves caught up in a fateful night in Los Angeles. A rookie trying to escape his father's shadow sees his first patrol turn into a disaster as he tries to find a missing girl and hunt down two murderers who have committed several crimes throughout the night. Meanwhile, his partner, a burned-out police officer, explains to him how the job works.

programme.title: Speed 2
programme.desc: Annie and her new boyfriend, Alex, a member of the Los Angeles police, decide to embark on a luxury cruise. Both intend to enjoy a few days of rest, but the long-awaited vacation turns into a nightmare when a terrorist takes command of the ship.

programme.title: The seductresses
programme.desc: Max and Page, mother and daughter, are two attractive con artists who use their charms to deceive and defraud naive millionaires. programme.title: Haute couture
programme.desc: Esther, first seamstress at the House of Dior, works on her latest Haute Couture collection, before retiring. Jade, a 20-year-old girl, steals her purse on the subway. Days later, repentant, she decides to go and return it. Esther decides to offer him a chance.

programme.title: McFarland
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the film tells the story of Jim White, a small-town California track coach who turns a small team of athletes into champions.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Dr. Franks is a prestigious neurosurgeon who is going to carry out a unique and very dangerous operation: implant the memories, secrets and abilities of CIA agent Bill Pope who has just died in the mind of another person. This is a cutting-edge method that is presented as the only way the agency has to recover confidential information of vital importance from Pope's memory that compromises the national security of the United States. The problem is that the only candidate to become the vessel of the deceased's mind is Jericho Stewart, a dangerous and unpredictable convict who is on death row awaiting execution and who has a brain abnormality that makes him perfect for the mission. However, no one can assure that the result is the most effective way to stop a terrible conspiracy that is hanging over the country.

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: Agent 47 has been genetically engineered to become an effective and lethal hitman, working under instructions from a mysterious group known as 'The Organization'. However, when he finds himself involved in a political conspiracy that is beyond his understanding, he will turn against what he has known until now to try to find out who has set him up. While Interpol and the Russian army search for him throughout Europe, the murderer will have to face two new elements in his life: conscience and love.

programme.title: Hitman. Agent 47
programme.desc: Based on the famous video game, Hitman is an elite assassin who has been genetically modified to become a perfect killing machine. Identified only by a barcode that he has tattooed, his target is a corporation that aims to reveal his past and create assassins more powerful than him.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the jungle
programme.desc: In 1996, a teenager disappears after opening a strange board game. Twenty years later, the sporty Fridge, the pretty Bethany, the geeky Spencer and the clever Martha are punished to clean a classroom at their high school, where they discover an old video game.

programme.title: Jumanji: next level
programme.desc: The lives of Spencer, Martha, Bethany and Fridge have gone their separate ways. The two girls and the sporty Fridge are eager to meet again for Christmas, but Spencer is not so sure.

programme.title: Morning Glory
programme.desc: Becky Fuller, an energetic TV producer, is fired from her job, her professional life becomes as bleak as her love life. To move forward with his career, he must face a new challenge: launching a morning magazine show on a New York channel.

programme.title: The good teacher
programme.desc: François Foucault, forty years old, is a literature professor at the prestigious Henri IV Institute in Paris. Due to various circumstances, he is forced to abandon it and accept a place in a center in a problematic area on the outskirts of the city, which requires him to adapt to another social reality.

programme.title: what a couple of cops
programme.desc: Two police officers are looking for a very expensive baseball card from 1952. They must rescue a Mexican supermodel and put an end to a drug organization.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Water has been a flashpoint in the Middle East and worldwide demand is outstripping supply, so how do we make sure there's enough to go round? This most basic resource is vital for drinking, sanitation and agriculture, but also for jobs and economies everywhere. The World Bank's global director for water Saroj Kumar Jha explains why they're trying to make it more of a priority for government spending. And Mareen Schneider, the founder and CEO of project developer Grasshopper Investments, explains how she's coming up with radical new ways for the private sector to invest in water. Plus, Ben Thompson also hears from José Manuel Entrecanales, the CEO of Spanish infrastructure giant Acciona, about the projects they're building around the world and why we need to rethink the value we give to water.

programme.title: Talking Movies
programme.desc: Talking Movies reviews Hollywood's summer movie season and the success of the blockbusters The Odyssey and Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Tom Brook and his team look back at the big successes, costly misses and surprise packages of recent months, including the triumph of low-budget horror films Obsession and Backrooms. The evolution of the summer blockbuster is also explored through the classic movie Jaws. Emma Jones examines the release of De Gaulle - one of the most expensive French films of all time - while Tom celebrates the centenary of Route 66 by looking at the diner as a classic location for iconic American films.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: Night Of Salvation
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: Night of Salvation melanjutkan kisah organisasi rahasia Dragon Inn yang menjalankan misinya sendiri untuk menghukum para pelaku kejahatan yang lolos dari hukum. Kali ini mereka menerima kasus hilangnya seorang gadis remaja yang tidak memiliki alasan untuk melarikan diri dari rumah. Dalam proses penyelidikan, mereka menemukan keterkaitan antara kasus tersebut dengan sebuah sekte keagamaan yang beroperasi secara mencurigakan. Ketika identitas dan lokasi Dragon Inn terbongkar akibat sebuah kesalahan, para anggota organisasi harus menghadapi ancaman yang semakin besar. Di tengah pertarungan melawan kelompok berbahaya tersebut, mereka berusaha menyelamatkan korban sekaligus mengungkap kebenaran di balik jaringan kejahatan yang tersembunyi. Film ini menghadirkan perpaduan aksi, misteri, dan ketegangan yang lebih intens dibanding pendahulunya.

programme.title: You Will Die In 6 Hours (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Jun Woo memperingatkan Jeong Yun tentang pembunuhan yang akan menimpanya. Dengan rasa skeptis, ia mulai menyelidiki dan menemukan keterkaitan Jun Woo dengan serangkaian pembunuhan. Ia pun berpacu dengan waktu untuk mengetahui apakah Jun Woo melindunginya atau justru menipunya sebelum kematian yang telah diramalkan itu terjadi.

programme.title: Confidential Assignment 2 (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Detektif Korea Utara kembali untuk misi rahasia lainnya. Meski memiliki alasan yang berbeda, tiga negara bergabung untuk menjatuhkan sebuah organisasi kejahatan internasional.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.
